node.title: A full canonical staircase support determines at most one codeword
node.statement: In the petal route, G2 passes the contributor's full agreement support R into the E22 canonical profile, with |R|=A>=k+sigma>=k. For fixed U and R, at most one degree-<k polynomial agrees with U on R, since the difference of two has at least k roots. Thus G3 has no per-class codeword multiplicity; only aggregate G1 chart overlap remains open.
